Thank you for your feedback. We apologize for the disappointing experience you had with your new grill, and we are sorry to learn that your new grill was not able to connect securely to the LP tank.
 
 In almost every case of reported leaks, the rubber gasket on the inside of the propane tank nozzle is oval in shape, as opposed to round, is cracked or is otherwise compromised, and therefore results in a leak. The gasket should be perfectly round, with no nicks or cracks.

We would like to offer further assistance, so please look for an email outreach from our Care team soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Wife wanted a grill for our cabin and insisted on getting a Weber.  The grill is high quality as expected.  We had to transport it a couple hours away, so we purchased unassembled for easy transport.  Assembly took some time however instructions were spot on and easy to follow. Grill is nice except for one flaw… there is no easy way to roll it around. The side with the wheels has a table that folds so there’s no a good way to move it around on the deck.  (Very awkward as a matter of fact.)  It cooks as expected.
Results.Title: Good Little Grill with one Flaw

Results.ReviewText: I had an old Weber 3 burner Genisis grill that I bought back in 1999. It even went underwater during super storm Sandy. And other than replacing grates it still worked. But as of this spring, time caught up and I had to part with it. It still worked but was very old. So I bought a new Spirit 3 burner grill. So far I love it. I have a summit 400 but the spirit is perfect for smaller jobs. Well made and cooks evenly and hot.
Results.Title: Great new grill

Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
